page: Microsoft Azure B8pls_v2 is a burstable ARM-based virtual machine configured with 8 vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at 3.0 GHz across 8 physical cores with single-threading, the instance features a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The processor includes 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, with hardware acceleration for AES cryptography. The server provides no bundled local ephemeral storage and does not include hardware accelerators such as GPUs.

Benchmark results reflect a clear separation between single-thread and multi-thread capabilities alongside moderate throughput. While single-core performance scores lower in Geekbench (1100.0) and PassMark CPU (6247.83), multi-core testing demonstrates solid scaling with a multi-core Geekbench score of 6176.0 and stress-ng multi-core CPU throughput of 14490.19. Memory tests indicate uncached large-block read bandwidth of 88.38 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 47.82 GB/sec. Application testing demonstrates steady operational capability, measuring 11.01 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks and 10.06 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

The burstable resource model provides an economical baseline for workloads with intermittent compute activity rather than constant sustained peak utilization. Because storage is not bundled, external storage attachments must be accounted for in system design. The 16.0 GB memory capacity paired with 8 physical ARM cores makes the B8pls_v2 best suited for scale-out microservices, CI/CD code compilation jobs, low-to-medium traffic web servers, and containerized development testing environments.
description: Microsoft Azure B8pls_v2 is an ARM-based burstable virtual machine equipped with 8 Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 physical cores operating at 3.0 GHz and 16.0 GB of system memory. Lacking local bundled storage and integrated GPUs, the instance relies on external storage volumes and offers a lean 2.0 GB of memory per vCPU. Synthetic testing shows modest single-core throughput, while multi-core compute tests such as Geekbench (6176.0) and stress-ng multi-core (14490.19) scale predictably. In operational application benchmarks, the server delivers 11.01 million Redis SET operations per second and 10.06 GB/sec of static web serving throughput. Designed around a burstable CPU credit architecture, the B8pls_v2 offers high resource density for intermittent computational demands. It is most effective for lightweight build pipelines, code compilation, containerized microservices, and general development or test environments.

tagline: An eight-core burstable ARM64 instance offering efficient multi-threaded performance and lightweight memory allocation for intermittent operational workloads.
bullet_points: Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor with 8 single-threaded cores clocked at 3.0 GHz
16.0 GB total system memory providing a compact 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio
